thread:
maria (observability): quick check — noticed a short 5xx bump on /v1/generate around 08:10 UTC, maybe ~300 errors in 3m. Can folks point me to the best dash and a trace sample?

ajay (sre): thx, can you paste the route and any request ids? I'll grab traces.

maria (observability): route is /v1/generate (prod). sample req id from logs: req=prod-8f3a2c. Dash link: https://dash.internal/redwood/requests?route=%2Fv1%2Fgenerate&since=2026-03-18T08:00Z (might need SSO)

li (platform): for quick traces use Observability > Request Explorer -> filter by req id or trace id. If you want raw logs: kubectl -n prod logs --selector=svc=ingress-gateway -c proxy | grep prod-8f3a2c

sam (oncall): I pulled a handful of traces, looks like gateway timeouts (504) where the upstream worker didn't respond before proxy timeout. A couple look like overloaded model pods (queue length spike).

nora (product): any user visible impact? I saw a couple support pings. Do we need to adjust SLO/alerts?

maria (observability): user-facing errors were ~0.05% at peak, small but visible. Current alert threshold is 0.1% over 5m, so it didn't fire. Thinking we should either lower to 0.05% or add a short-window burst alert. Thoughts?

ajay (sre): prefer burst alert on 1m with sensible debounce (3m) to avoid noisy runs. Also add path filter for /v1/generate.

li (platform): +1. Also suggest instrumenting queue depth metric on model pool; we only have latency and requests. If queue_depth > 10 for 30s -> paged alert (pagerduty).

maria (observability): can add that metric to the dashboard and create a chart. quick temp tweak: lower 5xx alert to 0.05% on 1m window for the route and add debounce 3m. I'll open a PR.

ajay (sre): pinging @sam for oncall routing change for the burst alert (if PR merges).

sam (oncall): got it. I'll take ownership once PR is up. Also recommend adding an automatic fallback policy to route to smaller model variant when queue depth spikes (cost vs availability tradeoff).

nora (product): is fallback safe for user flows? If hallucination risk increases we should gate by customer tier.

li (platform): we can make fallback policy per-customer tier. Config lives in infra configs repo: https://git.internal/redwood/infra-configs (see policies/fallbacks.md).

maria (observability): PR: https://git.internal/redwood/observability/pulls/142 — adds queue_depth chart, updates 5xx alert rule for /v1/generate (1m window, 0.05%, 3m debounce). Request reviews from @ajay and @li.

ajay (sre): reviewing now, small nit on severity mapping.

li (platform): reading, will comment on runbook link and fallback config pointer.
